consequence.text: Starting April 28, 2026, apps and games uploaded to App Store Connect need to meet the following minimum requirements: iOS and iPadOS apps must be built with the iOS 26 & iPadOS 26 SDK or later.

Upgrade to an Expo SDK whose default EAS image has Xcode 26 or later (table expo-sdk-defaults).
Build on a macOS runner with Xcode 26 or later and select it (table gha-runner-xcode).
Build and upload with Xcode 26 or later.

entries.applies_to: GitHub-hosted jobs on macos-14, macos-14-large or macos-14-xlarge

consequence.text: GitHub Actions will fully retire all macOS 14 images on November 2, 2026.

fix.text: Move these jobs to macos-latest, macos-15 or macos-26.

sources.quote: GitHub Actions will fully retire all macOS 14 images on November 2, 2026.
The macOS 14 runner image will be retired on November 2, 2026.

entries.title: macOS 14 runner images are retired

entries.applies_to: JavaScript actions whose action.yml declares runs.using node20, on GitHub-hosted runners

consequence.text: Node 20 is no longer available on GitHub Actions runners. Runners now use Node 24 for JavaScript actions.

fix.text: Upgrade to a release of the action that declares node24 (table action-runtimes), and check the job still passes on Node 24.

sources.quote: This is the final notification that Node 20 is no longer available on GitHub Actions runners. Runners now use Node 24 for JavaScript actions.
Keep accepting legacy action manifests, but execute all JavaScript actions using node24.

entries.title: Actions declaring node20 now run on Node 24

entries.applies_to: GitHub-hosted jobs on ubuntu-22.04 or ubuntu-22.04-arm (brownouts fail some jobs before the retirement)

consequence.text: Deprecation will begin on September 17th, 2026 and the images will be fully unsupported by April 17th, 2027.

fix.text: Move ubuntu-22.04 jobs to ubuntu-24.04, ubuntu-26.04 or ubuntu-latest, and ubuntu-22.04-arm jobs to ubuntu-24.04-arm or ubuntu-26.04-arm.

sources.quote: Workflows using the ubuntu-22.04, ubuntu-22.04-arm image labels will be terminated with an error.

entries.title: Ubuntu 22.04 runner images are retired on April 17, 2027

consequence.text: ubuntu-latest moves from Ubuntu 24.04 to Ubuntu 26.04: This change will be rolled out over a period of several weeks beginning October 19, 2026. We plan to complete the migration by November 19, 2026.

fix.text: If a job fails on Ubuntu 26.04, pin ubuntu-24.04 while you fix it; use ubuntu-26.04 to test the new image explicitly.
